Baseline reference: U.S. heavy cruiser; 3 built; auto-loading 8-inch guns; fastest-firing heavy guns ever.. The Des Moines class — three ships — were the ultimate gun cruisers: 21,500 tons with nine 8-inch/55 auto-loading guns firing 10 rounds per minute per barrel, the fastest-firing heavy guns ever put to sea.
